source_evidence.finding: Primary source explicitly labels T1-top open; it reports exact agreement through n<=34, wider ladder agreement, and long modular recurrence evidence, but does not provide a machine-certified unbounded proof object.
The script fixes p=4194301 and tests n in {5,9}; it verifies closed-form top cofactors on the support of the compact weight at sampled points and does not emit an unbounded T1-top certificate.
The retained log records only n=5 and n=9 support-component checks; theorem effect is NONE.

The source reports that the weight-5 harmonic annihilator timed out after 1800 seconds and that the weight-5 RISC elimination/certificate was not obtained; it expressly classifies the route as NOT MEASURED rather than proved or excluded.
A complete minimal order-7 telescoper is reported for the weight-3 companion. That success is not a certificate for T1-top and must not be promoted across representatives or weights.
The script works with PointData('w3') at fixed n and p and is not a deterministic producer for the source-locked w5_I T1-top identity.
The script reconstructs sampled modular rational-function directions for w3 and cannot serve as a source-normalized T1-top proof object.

certificate_search.interpretation: The governed source contains exploratory and finite modular certificate work, and a successful weight-3 certificate programme, but no emitted source-locked w5_I telescoper/direct certificate sufficient for independent exact replay. The 20-commit DELTA-003 source delta changes neither Sharp-12 nor work/z5la, so it does not repair this absence.

missing_objects.description: Deterministic producer bound to the exact w5_I target that emits a uniform proof object rather than finite sampled evidence.
Exact source-normalized telescoper or equivalent symbolic identity sufficient to identify S_n with P_n for all n.
Rational certificate functions or equivalent proof terms with canonical serialization and digest.
Complete denominator-clearing and removable-singularity manifest over the symbolic summation domain.
Exact cancellation certificates for all four finite-sum edges and corners under the locked endpoint convention.
Independent exact comparison showing the emitted recurrence equals L_BZ or implies it sufficiently, with nonvanishing propagation conditions.
Sufficient exact initial-value witness tied to the certified recurrence and source-normalized P_n.
Independent verifier that checks the emitted rational identities directly without invoking the producer's solver or creative-telescoping implementation.

reopening_requirements.requirement: Supply a deterministic producer locked to source commit/tree/path/blob, exact T, exact w5_I, endpoints, field, and normalization.
Emit a canonical unbounded symbolic proof object: exact telescoper plus certificates, direct two-dimensional certificate, or mathematically equivalent exact object.
Lock and verify denominator clearing, exceptional loci, removable singularities, all four boundary edges, and all corners.
For a recurrence route, prove exact recurrence equality or implication to L_BZ, sufficient initial values, and nonvanishing propagation on the claimed domain.
Provide an independently implemented verifier that consumes the proof object and does not call the producer's recurrence, solving, rank, or creative-telescoping engine.
Provide canonical digests, producer/verifier separation tests, and mutations rejecting coefficient, endpoint, boundary, denominator, recurrence, initial-value, representative, and source drift.
Pass governed replay, exact-head CI, independent non-author review, applicable Human Steward approval/disposition automation, protected merge, and post-merge readback.
